svg.text: HISTADA
Trilogy · part 1 · Board game · rules
Educational game for 1–12 players aged about 10+ · time: 30–120 min
Goal
You travel through time and space. Every
correct answer earns 10 points in one of
nine intelligences. The first to reach the
agreed goal (e.g. 1000 or 10,000 points)
wins – everyone finishes the round so all
players get the same number of turns.
Components
Board (A1 world map or 8 A4 sheets), 36
domain cards with a box, 12 character
sheets, dice: white d12, black d12, two grey
d6, 12 pawns or tokens, score sheet,
first-player marker.
Setup
Each player chooses a character and takes
its sheet and pawn. Pawns start on the START
fields (player numbers along the map edge).
Shuffle the domain cards and place them face
down on the CARD DECK field. Agree on a
points goal or a time limit.
Questions
Questions are shown by the HISTADA app (part
1, physical board mode): type or scan the
field, dice and card. The app picks 9
questions for the place, epoch, time
interval and domain, reads them aloud and
keeps score.
Player's turn
1. Roll all dice. The white d12 picks the
epoch (from the Beginning of the Universe to
the Future), the black d12 one of that
epoch's 12 time intervals, and the sum of
the grey d6 the maximum number of fields you
may move. 2. Move your pawn up to that many
fields. On your first turn, place your pawn
on any land field. 3. Draw a domain card and
put it on your character sheet. 4. Answer 9
questions – one for each intelligence.
Ports and the sea
Fields with a boat symbol are ports. Dashed
lines are fast sea routes: sailing between
connected ports counts as one step of
movement.
Points
For each correct answer add 10 points to
that intelligence's row and to the total row
(gear dials on the sheet or the score
sheet). Levels in each intelligence: Novice
10+, Adept 50+, Expert 150+, Master 300+,
Grandmaster 600+.
End of the game
When someone reaches the goal, finish the
round. The highest total wins. The app
issues everyone a PDF certificate with their
level in all nine intelligences.
